ActivationLinkResponse.description: Shown once. The link grants access to the account until it is used or expires.
ActivationLinkResponse.title: ActivationLinkResponse

AssistantBody.description: ``POST`` and ``PATCH``: only the fields sent are applied; ``description: null`` clears it.
AssistantBody.title: AssistantBody

AuditEventResponse.description: As stored: events never hold secrets, tokens, passwords, plain-text emails or document content.
AuditEventResponse.title: AuditEventResponse

ChatStreamRequest.description: No knowledge base IDs: the backend takes them from the assistant (ADR-005).
ChatStreamRequest.title: ChatStreamRequest

CitationResponse.description: The ``citation`` SSE event shape (API_CONTRACTS.md §3.3), from the snapshot of the answer.
CitationResponse.title: CitationResponse

DocumentResponse.description:
``current_version`` is the indexed one used by retrieval; ``latest_version`` the newest, which may
still be processing or have failed (its ``error_code`` says why).
DocumentResponse.title: DocumentResponse

JobError.description: Stored already redacted: a stable code and a short message without document content or secrets.
JobError.title: JobError

JobStage.description: Pipeline stages of ADR-008 §3, in order.
JobStage.title: JobStage

KnowledgeBaseReindexResponse.description: Documents with a queued or running job keep it; documents without a version are skipped.
KnowledgeBaseReindexResponse.title: KnowledgeBaseReindexResponse

ReadinessResponse.description:
``{"status": "ready"}`` or ``{"status": "not_ready", "checks": {...}}`` (API_CONTRACTS.md §2.1).

Only check names and ok/fail are exposed: no versions, hosts or error texts.
ReadinessResponse.title: ReadinessResponse

ReindexResponse.description: ``created`` is ``false`` when a queued or running job of the document is returned instead.
ReindexResponse.title: ReindexResponse

RetrievalBody.description: Ranges are checked by the use case (the same rules as retrieval itself).
RetrievalBody.title: RetrievalBody

SessionItem.description: One of the user's own sessions. Token hashes are never exposed.
SessionItem.title: SessionItem

SessionResponse.description: ``Session`` DTO. ``csrf_token`` must be kept in memory only and sent as ``X-CSRF-Token``.
SessionResponse.title: SessionResponse

SourceViewResponse.description: Text is data: the client renders it as plain text, never as HTML (API_CONTRACTS.md §2.11).
SourceViewResponse.title: SourceViewResponse

SyncJobResponse.description: A sync job; ``mode`` is ``initial`` when the source had no cursor yet (a full listing).
SyncJobResponse.title: SyncJobResponse

Unavailability.description: Why the current user cannot use an assistant (API_CONTRACTS.md §2.12).
Unavailability.title: Unavailability

UpdateEmbeddingProfileRequest.description: Only ``name`` and ``status`` change; a different model or vector setting → ``409 reindex_required``.
UpdateEmbeddingProfileRequest.title: UpdateEmbeddingProfileRequest

UpdateGroupRequest.description: ``description: null`` clears the description; an omitted field is left unchanged.
UpdateGroupRequest.title: UpdateGroupRequest

UpdateKnowledgeBaseRequest.description: Only the fields sent are changed; ``description: null`` clears the description.
UpdateKnowledgeBaseRequest.title: UpdateKnowledgeBaseRequest

UpdateModelRequest.description: ``model_id`` cannot change (create another model config). ``null`` clears an optional field.
UpdateModelRequest.title: UpdateModelRequest

UpdateProviderRequest.description: ``api_key``: absent → unchanged, string → replaced, ``null`` → removed. The type is immutable.
UpdateProviderRequest.title: UpdateProviderRequest

UserDetailsResponse.description: ``roles`` are the direct roles; roles inherited through ``groups`` are shown on each group.
UserDetailsResponse.title: UserDetailsResponse

post.description: Public: the one-time token from the activation link proves the right to set the first password.
Idempotent: without a valid session it only clears the cookie.
All sessions are revoked; this browser gets a new session cookie and CSRF token.

delete.description: Another user's session is reported as ``404``, exactly like a missing one.

get.description:
Public: the browser arrives from the provider. The pending authorization behind ``state`` must match
the current session; the answer always redirects to a UI path built by the server.

delete.description: Its documents leave search at once; their files, chunks and vectors are purged in the background.

get.description: Folders for the picker: the top level without ``parent_id``.

post.description: Queues a sync job (``409 sync_in_progress`` while one is queued or running); the worker runs it.
A fresh token, the account and the chosen folder; provider failures come back as ``failed``.

get.description: ``knowledge_base_id`` is required: documents are always listed through a knowledge base.

post.description: Fields must precede the file: access is checked before the file is read.

delete.description: The document leaves search at once; chunks, vectors and files are purged in the background.

get.description: The cited passage with its neighbours; access is checked again on every request.
Does not touch dependencies: a failing database must not get the process restarted.
